query:
UPDATE actions
            SET status = 'failed',
                status_at = $1,
                status_agent_id = NULL,
                status_reason = $2,
                leased_until = NULL,
                payload = CASE WHEN action_type = 'deployment.webhooks' THEN payload - 'headers' ELSE payload END
            WHERE deployment_id = $3
              AND id = $4
              AND status = 'leased'
